record_id.description: Stable UUID; retain through renames and changes in capacity.

name.description: Identifiable facility, phase or exact equipment name.

capacity_scope.description: Physical boundary and configuration covered by reported ratings.

notes.description: Review notes; no unsupported technical facts.

location_accuracy.description: Precision and method of public coordinates.

parent_record_id.description: Optional parent project UUID in this catalogue.

overlap_group.description: Stable group for overlapping capacity observations.

status_date_basis.description: Publication date or dated retrieval of undated evidence.

aggregation_role.description: Only independent or child records can contribute to sums. Aggregate and unresolved scopes are excluded even if filtered children are absent.

status.description: Last evidenced project lifecycle; a portfolio listing alone does not establish operation.

quality_status.description: Evidence qualification; does not certify a facility or product.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp; updated_at changes only on substantive data/evidence changes.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp; updated_at changes only on substantive data/evidence changes.

last_verified_at.description: UTC timestamp; updated_at changes only on substantive data/evidence changes.

status_as_of.description: ISO date; only precise reported dates, never a forecast treated as achieved.

aliases.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

sources.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

source_urls.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

owner_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

operator_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

developer_names.description: Explicit evidenced values; linked IDs refer to existing canonical records.

field_sources_json.description: Map each populated factual column to registered source IDs. No wildcard evidence.

evidence_json.description: Field-level locator, units, publication date/revision and confidence; keys match field_sources_json.

estimates_json.description: Derived estimates with method and uncertainty, never substituted into reported columns.

conflicts_json.description: Quarantined field observations and source dates/boundaries; unresolved numeric fields must be null.

extensions_json.description: Extra documented metadata with units and conditions.

latitude.description: Public source coordinate; no inferred centroids.

longitude.description: Public source coordinate; no inferred centroids.

installed_capacity_mw.description: Reported capacity at its explicit boundary; never substituted from turbine ratings.

planned_capacity_mw.description: Reported capacity at its explicit boundary; never substituted from turbine ratings.

historical_capacity_mw.description: Reported capacity at its explicit boundary; never substituted from turbine ratings.

storage_capacity_mwh.description: Explicitly reported usable electrical storage; never reservoir volume

cost_observations_json.description: Costs with currency, year and basis

cross_catalogue_links_json.description: Reviewed links to other catalogue identities
